content: Observation: proto-blue-codegen skips lexicons with 'number' type fields (observation.json and escalation.json use 'type: number'). Only evidencePointer.json was successfully loaded — it generates 1 doc / 5 files. The 'number' type is not in proto-blue-lexicon's type set (uses integer/float distinction). This is the actual state of codegen output — we include what generated, escalation+observation are skipped by the codegen tool. Will note this in the README and flag it in the report.
